newsitem.title: USA: PMR Corp names Fred Furman as president.
newsitem.headline: PMR Corp names Fred Furman as president.

text.p: PMR Corp said Monday it has appointed Fred Furman as president.

The company said in a statement that as part of a reorganization Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Allen Tepper has relinquished the title of president to devote his efforts to the continued creation of strategic initiatives.
Furman had previously served as chief administrative officer.
The company also said that the position of chief operating officer has been eliminated and Daved Frerker has left the company.
